_readme: Prompt data for music/generate.py. The pillar is (days since start_date) mod 3, in pillar_order. Each day picks one style, one bpm, two or three instruments, one mood for that day's pillar, and one texture, seeded by the date. Keep everything English, no artist names, no song titles, no vocals.

templates.Confidence: dark cinematic trap beat, 90 BPM, deep 808 sub bass, sparse crisp hi-hats, low brass hit, driving and bold, tight and punchy, instrumental
templates.Character: dark ambient orchestral, 70 BPM, low cello drone, steady taiko drum pulse, solemn and determined, heavy and dry, instrumental
templates.Respect: calm dark piano and strings, 65 BPM, soft felt piano, warm low strings, quiet and dignified, spacious reverb, instrumental
